- Vincent is a mechanic. Patrick Guzman is his long-time friend since their teenage years and works in construction. They share a blue-collar bond and often collaborate, combining Vincent’s mechanical skills with Patrick’s construction expertise.
- At a local diner, Vincent met Patrick and heard that Patrick was considering a new construction venture. Patrick said it seemed like a good opportunity to expand his business.
- Vincent told Patrick he had heard the venture was risky and asked if Patrick was sure. Patrick said he thought it was worth the risk but was still weighing his options.
- Vincent expressed worry about financial security and advised Patrick to reconsider or delay until he gathered more information. Patrick thanked him and said he would think it over.
- After a few days, Vincent noticed Patrick avoiding detailed discussions about the investment.
- At Patrick’s construction site, Vincent confronted Patrick, saying he felt Patrick was not telling him everything. Patrick said it was complicated and that he didn’t want to worry Vincent with the details.
- Vincent told Patrick they needed to discuss it, said he was Patrick’s friend, and said he felt betrayed by the lack of transparency. Patrick apologized, said he should have been more open, and promised to sit down and explain everything.
- During a detailed discussion at Vincent’s garage, Vincent learned the investment troubles were serious. Patrick told him it had been tough and that he might lose a significant amount if it didn’t turn around soon.
- Vincent offered to lend Patrick money to cover short-term losses. Patrick thanked him and expressed gratitude.
- A month later at a coffee shop, Vincent learned/observed that the venture might actually turn a profit. He told Patrick it looked like it might profit. Patrick agreed it was looking up and said he was relieved they stuck with it.
- Vincent apologized for doubting Patrick earlier and proposed a joint venture, saying he now saw a lot of potential. Patrick agreed and said they should work out the details.
- At Vincent’s house, Vincent and Patrick were optimistic about their joint venture. Vincent said that combining both their skills could make it a success. Patrick agreed and said he was excited.
- Vincent proposed starting the business plan and outlining every step carefully. Patrick agreed that they should cover all bases and set it up for success.

Vincent does not have access to Patrick’s private thoughts, internal reasoning, unspoken motives, or narrator-only information such as Patrick’s personality type or exact education unless Patrick told him or Vincent otherwise observed it.
